items.headline: U.S. Equities Retreat as Tech Sector Leads Declines Amidst Fed Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: U.S. stock markets closed lower today, with the technology sector bearing the sharpest pressure. Investors are closely monitoring the Federal Reserve's anticipated interest rate decision, widely expected to be a 25-basis-point hike, alongside rising oil prices and surging Treasury yields, which are contributing to a cautious market sentiment.

items.headline: Indaptus Therapeutics Leads Gainers
items.summary: Indaptus Therapeutics ($INDP) was among the day's top gainers, continuing a strong monthly performance.

items.headline: Intel Rises on Potential SK Hynix Partnership & Strong Earnings
items.summary: Intel ($INTC) shares rose 5% today following reports of potential memory chip manufacturing talks with South Korea's SK Hynix in the U.S. and stronger-than-expected earnings.

items.headline: SK Hynix Up on Intel Manufacturing Talks
items.summary: SK Hynix ($SKHY) saw its shares climb 3% amidst discussions with Intel regarding potential memory chip production in the United States.

items.headline: Swarmer Experiences Significant Decline
items.summary: Swarmer ($SWMR) fell 28.4% today, reflecting persistent weakness in the stock.

items.headline: Alphabet Shares Slip Amid AI Spending Concerns
items.summary: Alphabet ($GOOGL) shares slipped as investors raised questions regarding the pace of the company's artificial intelligence investments.

items.headline: Tesla Under Pressure Post-Earnings
items.summary: Tesla ($TSLA) stock remained under pressure today, continuing its struggle following its recent earnings report.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Poised for Rate Hike Decision
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting is set to conclude, with market participants widely anticipating a 25-basis-point interest rate hike. All eyes are on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's post-decision remarks for guidance on future policy, as uncertainty persists regarding the pace of further tightening.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Released; U.S. Retail Sales Ahead
items.summary: Today saw the release of UK August CPI and retail price index data, as well as Eurozone July industrial production. The U.S. is scheduled to release its August retail sales data later today, offering further insights into consumer spending.

items.headline: Inflation Concerns Mount Amidst Rising Oil Prices and Treasury Yields
items.summary: Global markets continue to grapple with elevated inflation concerns, exacerbated by Brent crude prices nearing $107-$108 per barrel and WTI crossing the $104 mark. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield has surged above 5%, levels not seen since the Great Financial Crisis, fueled by inflation fears and substantial government debt issuance.

items.headline: Technology Sector Retreats Under Pressure
items.summary: The U.S. technology sector experienced a significant pullback today, contributing heavily to the broader market retreat. Rate-sensitive growth names in tech are particularly affected by the ongoing discussions around higher interest rates.
